title: One physical waiting and finite endpoint compose under continuous correlated noise
statement: The fresh whole review accepts the continuous Bell-assisted recipient on one actual physical instance: common admitted waiting, joint positive source, both-laboratory activity, forward-C/inverse-B shutoff, finite boot/readout/transport and activation. Its reference-uniform error is 2 eta_source + C polynomial(N)(1+T+tau) exp(-cN). Encoded Q, raw Bell source, distinct controller tags, finite controls/bandwidth and ideal DATA recovery remain supplied. This is not preset routing, arbitrary prehistory composition or autonomous command selection.
